svg.title: Pelican Bay · 鹈鹕湾 — 骑自行车的鹈鹕 · A pelican riding a bicycle
svg.desc: 一只大白鹈鹕在黄金时刻沿鹈鹕湾的海滨公路骑车。零 JavaScript 的 SVG：4 秒无缝循环（60 rpm 下 4 圈曲柄），由实时骨架逐帧烘焙为 SMIL。 A great white pelican rides a bicycle along the seaside road at Pelican Bay. Zero-JavaScript SVG: a seamless 4 s SMIL loop (4 crank turns at 60 rpm) baked frame by frame from the live rig.
